div.div:
1 Snapshot from the rows (every cycle, one REPEATABLE READ transaction)
live = admitted + running + granted resumes; open adds paused and resume-pending
waiting resumes: resume-pending with requested_action resume
every 10th cycle, the scans: accepted with control_seq > 0 and no action,
and admitted older than 60 s with no workflow (at most 50 describes)

div.div:
2 Plan (pure policy)
strict class order, every 5th grant to the lowest waiting class
inside a class: resumes and re-admissions first, then tenants round-robin
never past the global cap, a tenant quota or a job class cap,
and no queue grant past the open-workflow cap
